summary: Idaho County lookout on the Nez Perce National Forest: a cab on a 10-foot log tower c.1930, destroyed in the 1960s. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 10-foot round native log tower with a cab; log cabin living quarters
facts.status_note: Destroyed in the 1960s; no source describes what remains at the site.

staffing.status: Bert Nixon named as known staff, staffed for 35 years (Idaho Fire Lookouts)

access.note: No source we read gives access rules for the site.

events.note: Cab on a 10-foot log tower, dated c.1930 or about 1930
Listed under the 1930s; Bert Nixon named as staff for 35 years

sources.title: History of Forest Fire Lookouts on the Nez Perce National Forest

notes_for_editor: Gone tower; no source describes the site today. Sources agree on a c.1930 build and a 1960s destruction, but none gives a year. Bert Nixon's 35 years is the only staffing record. Brief agency and county confirmed by Forest Lookouts. Brief height 3.0 m rounds the 10-foot tower (about 3.05 m). No photos added.
